sos.text: Tam is one of five new students who choose their colleges at Strixhaven, and she goes with Lluwen to Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Oracle Jadzi greets them.

She comforts Lluwen about the spirit that threw a spear at her group, tells him that archaics were once oracles and suggests talking to Jadzi, and then freezes when a massive creature looms over the camp and Jadzi goes missing.
After the archaic's attack Tam wakes beneath the earth, invites the Shattered to join the group, and shows she knows Fel once sought to save the woman he loved.
When the students run toward the fight where reality is tearing apart, Tam pushes Jadzi into the churning pit of magic, telling her friends "I was made to do this" before stepping in herself.

fra.text: Tam wakes after being made by the Theorist, who tells her that her name is Tamira but that who she is is up to her, and she later returns to Hexhaven with the captured Jadzi feeling empty rather than victorious.
She learns that the Theorist plans to overwrite the existing Multiverse and that Jadzi must die, and she tells him that he used her to bring Jadzi to her death.
Tam learns from Liliana that overwriting would smother the souls of everyone in the original Multiverse, and when she tells the Theorist "I won't help you anymore!" he silences her.

She warns Vraska that the Theorist can only be beaten by a telepath, tells her to rescue Jadzi, and heals the injured allies, then frees Liliana from her cell and asks her to stop Jace before he kills Jadzi.
